WITH m AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') = '2018-03') AS mar_orders,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') = '2018-04') AS apr_orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2018-03-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-05-01'
)
SELECT
  mar_orders,
  apr_orders,
  (apr_orders - mar_orders)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(mar_orders, 0) AS relative_growth
FROM m;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month,
         COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM orders
  WHERE strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') IN ('2017-08', '2017-09')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2017-08' THEN orders END) AS orders_2017_08,
  SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2017-09' THEN orders END) AS orders_2017_09,
  (SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2017-09' THEN orders END) - SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2017-08' THEN orders END))::DOUBLE
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN month = '2017-08' THEN orders END), 0) AS relative_growth
FROM monthly;

WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-08-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-09-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-04-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01'
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable');

SELECT dayname(order_purchase_timestamp) AS weekday, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2017-12-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT dayname(order_purchase_timestamp) AS weekday, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-12-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable');

WITH delivered AS (SELECT order_id, order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date, order_estimated_delivery_date FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL) SELECT strftime(order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, ROUND(AVG(date_diff('day', order_purchase_timestamp, order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS DATE) > CAST(order_estimated_delivery_date AS DATE) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 4) AS late_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS delivered_orders FROM delivered GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category_en = 'health_beauty' AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-09-01';
